issues.body: LABEL_WRITE_PATTERNS still lacks GitHub GraphQL label mutations such as addLabelsToLabelable and removeLabelsFromLabelable. scripts/bd-to-issues.py contains a real addLabelsToLabelable mutation, but discover_label_writing_scripts() therefore does not classify it as a label-writing script. A workflow invoking that script with REGISTRY_RING_TOKEN, KB_DUMP_TOKEN, or another foreign PAT in scope will make step_writes_labels() return false and skip R1/R2. This is materially the same major completeness defect reported in round 4.
issues.fix_hint: Recognize the repository's GraphQL label mutation spellings, at minimum addLabelsToLabelable and removeLabelsFromLabelable, and add a positive self-test that invokes the real GraphQL-writing script with a foreign credential. Add a negative GraphQL label-read fixture if the chosen matcher could confuse reads and writes.
issues.title: GraphQL label writes still bypass the identity guard

verdict.summary: Round 5 does not address round 4's major finding. The new detector still recognizes REST/CLI and JavaScript-style method calls only; it has no pattern for GitHub GraphQL label mutations. The repository's existing scripts/bd-to-issues.py uses addLabelsToLabelable, so discovery still fails to classify that real script as a label writer. Consequently, a workflow step invoking it with a foreign PAT in scope can still bypass both R1 and R2. The added REST method fixtures do not exercise the reported GraphQL gap.
